python_role: Factual extraction, serialization, numerical grading, integrity checks and report rendering only
known_outcomes: Already reviewed and used to develop V2. This retest is NOT blind, prospective or independent validation.
evidence_policy: Reuse the exact validated V1 preweek packages and causal-prefix checks, preserving the accepted extractor and 90/96/120/160 windows. No target-week rows enter forecast evidence.
levels_policy: Retain V1 preweek zone boundaries for comparability; two explicit Codex scenario changes (29 June, 12 October). The 29 June alternative adds a preweek-only HIGH zone. No active live map is changed.
horizon_policy: Weekly closing preference is distinct from the conditional first-leg direction. UNRESOLVED is a weekly research preference, not an EVALUATE verdict.
comparisons: V1 versus V2 first-leg directional agreement on all 20 weeks, same field and same denominator
V2 explicit closing preference on resolved weeks with coverage and all-20 hit counts
V1 primary direction as the historical closing-direction proxy on the same V2-resolved subset, labelled as a proxy rather than a true separate V1 closing forecast
Always BUY and always SELL baselines on all 20 and the identical resolved subset
Origin-to-target and completed-H4 failure chronology, interpreted by Codex, no entry success inferred
opening_policy: After maps are frozen, extract the first observed completed M15 interval of each target week as the opening review cutoff. Codex assesses current premise separately; no opening evidence changes the preweek forecast or scoring denominator.
entry_performance: UNSCORED; no full EVALUATE/no-chase replay or profitability claim
prospective_journal: Unchanged; historical retest does not populate any future forecast/result record.
